fusions.name: Three-Part Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a bolt through three arms in turn that deals 8 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Word of Binding
fusions.desc: Speaks a binding word, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Spell Said Twice
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Practiced Cadence
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
